% Adapted from the TeX Live circuitikz manual's waveform-symbol rotation example.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{circuitikz}
\begin{document}
\begin{circuitikz}[thick]
  % The default is 90 degrees in the component-local frame.
  \draw (0,2) to[sqV] (3,2);
  \draw (4,2) to[sqV] (4,5);

  % auto cancels the component's line rotation, keeping the symbol orientation fixed.
  \ctikzset{sources/symbol/rotate=auto, sources/symbol/thickness=1.5}
  \draw[red] (0,0) to[sqV] (3,0);
  \draw[red] (4,0) to[sqV] (4,-3);

  \draw (0,-5) to[tV] (3,-5);
  \draw (4,-5) to[tV] (4,-8);

  \ctikzset{sources/symbol/rotate=45}
  \draw[blue] (0,-10) to[sV] (3,-10);
  \ctikzset{csources/symbol/rotate=auto}
  \draw[blue] (4,-10) to[csV] (4,-13);
\end{circuitikz}
\end{document}
